pipeline.heading: Publish pipeline
pipeline.intro: Every step between the call ending and the meeting being published. These apply to every room.
pipeline.current_title: The saved settings new recordings get
pipeline.off_description: Recordings are published without a transcript.
pipeline.quality_balanced_description: Default — good accuracy at reasonable speed.
pipeline.lead_downloading: Downloading the {tier} model. Transcription turns on when it finishes.
pipeline.lead_off: Nothing is transcribed. Install and pick a model to turn transcription on.
pipeline.lead_on_unsaved: Transcription is on. Save to apply it to new recordings.
pipeline.lead_switched: Now transcribing with the {tier} model. Save to apply it.
pipeline.lead_switched_unnamed: Now transcribing with the chosen model. Save to apply it.
pipeline.lead_tier: Transcribing every recording with the {tier} model.
pipeline.gpu_same_model: On the GPU, every quality setting uses the same full-precision model, so this only changes transcription on the CPU.
pipeline.downloads_disabled: Downloads are disabled. Prepare a package with {pack} on a connected machine, copy it here, and run {import} inside this server's Cassini runtime. Imported models appear here automatically.
pipeline.transcript_only_without: Saved settings publish transcript-only meetings with no transcript. Save to publish the audio instead.
pipeline.in_use_missing: {model} isn't installed, so recordings get no transcript.

pipeline.in_use_stand_in_failed_check: {model} is installed but failed its runtime check; the previous model transcribes recordings on {device} meanwhile.
pipeline.in_use_stand_in_missing: {model} isn't installed; the previous model transcribes recordings on {device} meanwhile.
pipeline.hw_device_help: Auto uses the GPU when there is one. Change it only if the hardware above is wrong.
pipeline.hw_no_gpu_forced: No GPU was found, so recordings won't be processed on this setting.
pipeline.hw_cuda_tip: For faster transcription, run Cassini's CUDA image on a server with a GPU.

templates_panel.title: Insight templates
templates_panel.intro: Used for insights and meeting summaries. Write your own, or duplicate a built-in one and change it.
templates_panel.description_hint: Shown to the person choosing it, so they know what it does.
templates_panel.prompt_hint: The instruction the model receives, together with the transcripts.
templates_panel.prompt_question_hint: Put {placeholder} where a question should go, and people will be asked for one when they pick this template.
templates_panel.prompt_example:
You read meeting transcripts and list the risks people raised.

Write a Markdown document with one heading, ## Risks, and under it one bullet per risk:
what the risk is, who raised it, and what was agreed about it.
If nobody raised a risk, say so in one line.
templates_panel.template_placeholder_problem: A custom template has no place for {placeholder}. Write the shape of the document into the prompt instead.
templates_panel.cannot_save_under_name: {file} cannot be saved under its own name. Saving keeps this as a new template and removes that file.

templates_panel.built_in_note: Shipped with Cassini. Duplicate one to change it.

templates_panel.delete_note: Insights that have already been produced from it will keep a reference to its name, id, version and hash.
